title: Graph Traversal
summary: Explore vertices through edges while recording discovered state so each relevant vertex is processed without getting trapped in cycles or repeated paths.
recognition_signals: entities have arbitrary relationships rather than a strict hierarchy
the task asks about reachability or connected components
cycles or multiple parents may exist
core_rules: Mark discovery early enough to prevent repeated traversal through cycles.
Choose DFS or BFS according to the query; simple reachability does not require shortest-path ordering.
structural_steps: process one frontier or recursive vertex
continue until the reachable region is exhausted

common_confusions.distinction: General traversal answers reachability and structure questions. Unweighted shortest-path BFS additionally relies on FIFO layer order to guarantee minimum hop count.
